labeling_note: Desktop/web LLM application supporting multiple providers; model-owned criteria are not applicable.

criteria.rationale: Node dependencies are declared in package.json.
A Docker Compose environment is provided.
The application ingests user documents but does not own a project dataset pipeline.
The application supports multiple model providers and does not own a model card.
MIT applies to the code; no project-owned model license is involved.
Server tests and CI workflows provide executable verification.
No training experiment is conducted by the application.
Tests, CI and Docker build workflows are present.
Prompt features are documented, but no prompt version or hash metadata is recorded.
Model-agnostic application; no fixed project-owned sampling configuration is expected.
Vector databases are supported, but index/embedding versions are not recorded.
Agent functionality exists, but no durable tool-call trace artifact is documented.
No evaluation dataset, data split, or contamination protocol is documented.
Token usage is mentioned, but no reproducible cost or latency measurement is provided.
